gold: Multiple hereditary infundibulocystic basal cell carcinoma syndrome (MHIBCC)

selector.rationale: The presence of multiple dome-shaped, skin-colored papules, histopathology showing buds and cords of basaloid cells, and a conserved splice-site mutation in the SUFU gene support Nevoid basal cell carcinoma syndrome.

rejected.label: Gorlin syndrome
rejected.why: While some features are similar, the absence of palmar or plantar pits and jaw cysts, along with a stronger support for Nevoid basal cell carcinoma syndrome, leads to its rejection.
